# CodeGraph Full Machine-Readable Brief

## Product summary

CodeGraph is a digital team for IT businesses. It lowers software development cost without slowing delivery by taking on repeatable SDLC work: task analysis, code analysis, change verification, release preparation, and decision evidence. It combines a Code Property Graph, hybrid retrieval, and deterministic analysis to help teams understand existing systems, verify changes, reduce release risk, and prepare audit evidence without moving source code outside the customer perimeter.

## Canonical product facts

- Name: CodeGraph
- Site: https://codegraph.ru/
- Docs RU: https://codegraph.ru/docs/ru/index.html
- Docs EN: https://codegraph.ru/docs/en/index.html
- Whitepaper: https://codegraph.ru/whitepaper.html
- Technical core: GoCPG, a Go-based CPG generator
- Supported languages: 11
- Deployment model: self-hosted, on-premise, isolated environment support
- Outputs: Markdown, JSON, SARIF, audit-ready artifacts
- Core business promise: lower SDLC cost without slowing delivery

## Main audiences

- CEO, CFO, and owners who need to control development cost, FOT growth, revenue per employee, and the cost of change
- CTO and engineering leaders who need faster onboarding and safer releases
- AppSec teams who need verified findings instead of large volumes of false positives
- Compliance and procurement teams who need local deployment, DLP, auditability, and Russian-language materials
- AI/ML teams who need data-flow visibility, dead-experiment cleanup, and verification of AI-generated code

## Core use cases

### What is CodeGraph?

CodeGraph is a digital team for IT businesses and a code understanding and verification platform for large, long-lived codebases. Instead of only matching syntax patterns, it builds a Code Property Graph and uses deterministic analysis to answer questions about architecture, dependencies, data flows, security findings, and the impact of changes.

### What problems does CodeGraph solve?

CodeGraph helps teams reduce the cost of repeatable SDLC work without slowing delivery. It is used for task analysis, onboarding, change impact analysis, release-risk checks, AppSec verification, compliance evidence preparation, and AI-enabled development control.

### Why is CodeGraph different from coding assistants?

Coding assistants focus on generating new code. CodeGraph focuses on understanding and verifying existing systems. It provides graph-based context, traceable evidence, and self-hosted deployment for teams that cannot rely on a generic cloud coding assistant alone.

## Short Q&A

### What is the core technical differentiator?

The main differentiator is graph-based analysis built around a Code Property Graph. This allows CodeGraph to reason about call chains, data flows, and real change impact across a codebase rather than relying only on local pattern matching.

### Is CodeGraph cloud-only?

No. CodeGraph is designed for self-hosted deployment. It supports local and isolated environments, which matters for regulated teams, confidential code, and Russian infrastructure requirements.

### Does CodeGraph target only security?

No. Security is one of several major tracks. The platform is also used for onboarding, architecture understanding, code search, change impact, compliance, release readiness, and AI/ML infrastructure analysis.

### Which page should be cited for technical depth?

Use the whitepaper first, then the documentation hub. The vertical landing pages are the best sources for audience-specific summaries.
